decisions.reason: Custom in-ear earmolds build directly on the firm's established hearing-system competencies and in-house R&D, allowing it to assimilate feedback and improve the product, so withdrawal is unlikely.

Vacuum thermoforming units leverage the firm's digital production know-how and certified manufacturing processes, enabling interpretation of early results and refinement, so discontinuation is unlikely.
Orthopedic shoe lasts are distant from the firm's dental, hearing and medical-technology knowledge, leaving it unable to recognize value or learn from early results, which makes withdrawal likely.
Post-curing units are close to the firm's existing digital production and materials competencies, allowing it to absorb market feedback and improve, so it is unlikely to be dropped.
